turn_text: I Hate Politics is a podcast about a human activity we love to hate. And this is the I Hate Politics candidate interview with Sarah Alfred for Congress in Maryland's Third District. I'm Sunil Daskypta, host of I Hate Politics, a podcast about our neighborhoods, workplaces, schools and streets and our local governments as they function in diverse, democratic and sometimes divided societies. Rather than ask how they stand on a multitude of issues, these conversations go in depth on a few issues and reveal the character of the candidates. District 3 that centers around Howard and Anne Arundel County. And District 6 which starts in Montgomery and goes all the way to the mountains of Western Maryland. The primary election in Maryland's 3rd district has a crowded field. Among the leading candidates is Sarah Elfreth, State Senator from Anne Arundel County since 2019. You can find interviews with other candidates in the IHIT Politics library available on all major streaming platforms. Music for this episode are two short piano pieces from Kensington resident Adam Babro. If you want to share your music on the show or know someone else who might want to, please email us at producer at IHPPod.org. Sarah Elfreath, welcome to our hate politics.

turn_text: I think we are often asked to make kind of false policy choices between the economy and the environment generally, and I don't think we always have to. We just made the goal and walked away. And the market reacts the way the market reacts. So we stepped back here in Maryland last year and said, well, how do we incentivize our renewable energy goals where we want them the most and where they have the greatest ecological benefit?
